title: Training and Placement Cell
content:
DAVIET has a full-fledged Training & Placement Cell for final-year and pre-final-year students. Published support includes arranging campus interviews, student grooming, and industrial/practical training. Facilities mentioned for placement activities include two centrally air-conditioned auditoriums (seating capacity about 1200 and 350) for pre-placement talks, conference rooms for group discussions, a seminar hall, and rooms/offices for interviews. The Placement Office is described as fully computerized.

The Steering Committee is headed by the Training & Placement Officer (Assistant Professor rank) with industrial coordinators from each department and student placement coordinators.

Published objectives include maximizing placements, guiding students on interviews/GDs/aptitude tests, providing industrial training opportunities, and bridging industry–academia gaps via feedback, workshops and seminars.

Other listed activities: IQ tests, personality development workshops, aptitude/interview/GD training, competitive exam notifications, industrial visits, and guidance for higher education.

Official About page also notes alliances with many companies for internships/jobs and recent internship/employment outcomes; treat specific package figures as time-sensitive and verify on the official site.
